s: Dine hagalat kelim ubo a"ch seipim: kol hakkelim sheeno rotzeh lehakshiran lepesach al yede hagala o libbun, veken kol kele cheres sheen lahem heksher al yede hagala velibbun, im hu rotzeh lehashhotan ad leachar happesach — tzarik leshapshepan (ayyen siman tm"d) heteb qodem shaa shishshit beereb pesach velahadichan meat beinyan shello yehe chametz nikkar bahen, veyatzniem bemaqom tzanua sheeno ragil lelek lesham kol yeme happesach, kede shello yishkach veyishtammesh bahen bepesach. Veap al pi shekkol hakkelim habbeluim mishshear issurin muttar lehashhotan immo babbayit veen chosheshin leshikcha, mikkol maqom chametz kevan shehu ragil bo kol hashshana yesh lachosh bo yoter leshikcha. Vetob lesogram becheder meyuchad ulehatznia hammapteach shello yelek lesham kol yeme happesach:

Umikkol maqom, derek aray umiqreh muttar lehotzian mimmaqom shehitznian ulehishtammesh bahen dabar tzonen, ben lach uben yabesh. Raq sheyyizzaher lehadiach et hakkeli heteb qodem shemmishtammesh bo, shello yihyeh shum mashshehu chametz dabuq bo beayin (uleinyan diabad — ayyen siman tm"z). Vaapillu hi qedera shel cheres shennitbashshel bah chametz kol hashshana — day lah bahadacha lehishtammesh bah tzonen bepesach meiqqar haddin (abal hamminhag hu shello lehishtammesh kelal bepesach bikle cheres yeshanim apillu betzonen, kemo sheyyitbaer). Veim hu sakkin — tzarik lenaatzo eser peamim beqarqa qasha qodem shemmishtammesh bo tzonen bepesach. Abal asur lehishtammesh bahen biqbiut mishshaa h' beereb pesach vaelak apillu betzonen ad sheyyakshirem lepesach al yede hagala o libbun, al derek sheyyitbaer, gezera shemma yishkach veyishtammesh bahen bechammin:

Im shakach beereb pesach velo shipshep et hakkelim mechametz haddabuq bahen venizkar betok happesach, im hu chol hammoed (abal beshabbat veyom tob asur ligga behechametz apillu kede lebaaro, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"v ayyen sham) — tzarik leshapshepan miyyad shennizkar. Veen chosheshin shemma yishkach veyokal mehechametz beshaa shennogea bo keshemmeshapshepo, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tl"h. Veim abar happesach velo shipshepan — tzarik leshapshepan leachar happesach lehaabir mehen hechametz haddabuq bahen, shehu asur bahanaa mippene sheabar alayv happesach:

Yesh nohagin lesadder kele bedil shel chametz betok habbayit begobah hakkotel bemaqom sheen yad adam maggaat lesham, vehem sedurin sham kol yeme happesach lenoy, veen limchot beyadam. Veap al pi shekkol dabar sheggazeru alayv chakamim mechamat chashash shemma yishkach veyishtammesh bo lo chillequ bigzeratam veaseru apillu higbiah oto dabar eser qomot, kemo shennitbaer besiman ra"h vesiman sh"z, mikkol maqom kevan sheissur zeh sheasur lehashhot kele chametz betok habbayit bepesach lo gazeru alayv chakme haggemara ella chakme haddorot haacharonim hu shehechemiru ken, lepikak en lehachamir bo kol kak. Ubiprat sheal pi harob en hakkelim bene yoman mibbeliat hechametz beshaa shemmesadderin otam beereb pesach begobah hakkotel. Zehu taam hamminhag. Umikkol maqom, hammachamir lehatznian bemaqom tzanua — tabo alayv beraka:

Nokri hammoker kelim chadashim bashshuq, ben shel cheres ben shel mattakot ben shel zekukit — loqechin mimmennu kol keli shehu nireh chadash, veen chosheshin shemma nishtammesh bo hannokri paam achat, shekkol keli heasuy limkor en mishtammeshin bo kelal. Abal im niknas lebet hannokri liqqach mimmennu kelim chadashim — lo yiqqach ella keli chadash shemmakkir bo heteb shello nishtammesh bo adayin. Abal im yesh lehistappeq shemma nishtammesh bo paam achat ap shehu nireh chadash — en leloqcho, ella im ken hannokri mesiach lepi tummo shello nishtammesh bo adayin, o shehu loqeach keli echad mittok harbeh kelim, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman qk"b ayyen sham, lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma asao hannokri letzorek atzmo ukebar nishtammesh bo paam achat veachar kak nimlak lemokro leyisrael habba elayv. Umikkol maqom, bikle zekukit yesh lehattir liqnot hatztzelulim apillu en hannokri mesiach lepi tummo veeno loqeach keli mittok hakkelim, dekevan shehem tzelulim bevadday lo nishtammesh bahem adayin:

Kol keli cheres shennishtammesh bo chametz bechammin shehayyad soledet bo beinyan shekkayyotze bo bishar kelim tzerikin hagala, abal keli cheres en lo taqqana al yede hagala, shehattora heida al keli cheres sheeno yotze mide dopyo (perush giul hannibla bo) leolam, apillu yagilennu kamma peamim, ella leolam polet hu meat meat bekol hagala, veiqqar giul habbalua betoko eno niplat mimmennu legamre, ukesheyyebashshelu bo hetter apillu achar kamma hagalot — yiplot meat mehabbalua shebbetoko letok hattabshil. Vehekan heida tora kak? Gabbe kelim habbeluim minnotar, sheomra tora: "ukeli chere[s] asher tebushshal bo yishshaber", lamadnu mikkan sheen hagala moelet likli cheres:

Umikkol maqom, qibbelu chakamim sheyyesh likli cheres heksher al yede libbun baur, dehaynu sheyyassiqennu kol kak ad sheyyihyu nitzotzot nittazim mimmenna, sheaz nisrap venikleh kol haissur habbalua betoko:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmassiqo mibbipnim (perush betok chalal hakkeli), vegam derek hesseqo kol hashshana hu mibbipnim, kegon tannur shel cheres vekayyotze bo. Abal keli cheres shedderek hesseqo kol hashshana hu mibbachutz, kegon qedera umachabat vetappeqa shel cheres, dehaynu keli cheres shemmassiqin oto tachtayv millematta veopin al gabbayv millemala, ap im hu rotzeh lehakshiro al yede hesseq mibbipnim, kegon sheyyemalleennu gechalim boarot — en zeh moil kelum, gezera shemma yachus alayv shello yitbaqqea mechamat haggechalim, kevan sheen zeh darko bekol hashshana. Velo yemalleennu gechalim boarot veyassiqennu mibbachutz vehesseq chitzon eno moil kelum min hattora, shehare haissur nishtammesh venibla bipnimit hakkeli vetzarik lehaplito gam ken derek penimit hakkeli, di"keboleo kak poleto" kemo sheyyitbaer, ukeshemmassiqo mibbachutz en haissur niplat derek penimit hakkeli al yede hesseq chitzon zeh:

Vaapillu im rotzeh lehassiqo mibbipnim umibbachutz, kegon shemmakniso reqan letok hattannur male esh, sheshshalhebet ola mikkol tzedade hakkeli, umelabbeno yapeh mibbipnim umibbachutz — en zeh moil kelum, gezera shemma yachus alayv shello yitbaqqea veyotziennu min hattannur terem sheyyitlabben yapeh yapeh ad sheyyihyu nitzotzot nittazim mimmennu. Abal im machaziro letok kibshan male esh shemmetzorpin bo kele cheres chadashim — hare zeh muttar lehishtammesh bo bepesach, dekevan shemmaknisan lehesseq gadol kazeh bevadday eno choshesh alehem im yitbaqqeu:

Vekol zeh bikli cheres, abal bikli mattakot sheeno nipqa mechamat chom haesh — hare hu yakol lemalloto gechalim mibbipnim veyashheh otam betoko, ad sheim yigga adam batztzad hachitzon shel hakkeli yihyeh hayyad soledet bo mechamat shennitlabben hakkeli min haggechalim, sheaz bevadday nisrap kol hechametz habbalua betoko. Ap al pi shello nitlabben kol kak ad sheyyihyu nitzotzot nittazim mimmennu, shehare kele mattakot hen niksharin al yede hagala, velibbun qal hazzeh eno garua mehagala:

Bukeya (vehu keli heasuy millebenim veapar umassiqin oto mibbachutz veopin umetaggenin betoko), im hissiqo mibbachutz — eno nikshar lepesach al yede hesseq zeh kemo shennitbaer, abal im milleuhu gechalim mibbipnim, o shehissiqo mibbipnim ad shennitlabben kedino veal derek sheyyitbaer besiman ts"a — muttar lehishtammesh bo bepesach. Veen lachosh shemma lo yelabbeno yapeh yapeh mechamat sheyyachus alayv shello yitbaqqea, dekevan shehu asuy millebenim veapar — en lachosh bo shemma yitbaqqea:

Lepikak, lebenim shennishtammesh bahen chametz kol hashshana — muttar lelabbenam baur ulehishtammesh bahen bepesach. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bilbenim shennitzrepu bekibshan, abal lebenim shennityabbeshu bachamma im lo nishtammesh bahen chametz al yede haur kemo tzeliyya vaapiyya ella shennishpak alehem tabshil roteach shel chametz — en tzerikim libbun, veday lahem behagala kishar kele adama kemo sheyyitbaer, umuttar leepot velitzlot alehem bepesach:

Abal im nishtammesh bahen chametz al yede haur, veken shear kol hakkelim apillu shel mine mattakot shennishtammesh venibla bahen chametz al yede haur bilbad shello al yede mashqeh, kegon hashshappudim vehaaskelaot shetztzalu alehem muleyta shel chametz, sheggup hechametz nogea bahen bishat tzeliyyato, veen benehem shum mashqeh (topeach) sheyyolik taam hechametz letok hashshappud vehaaskela, ella al yede chom haesh bilbad nibla bahem taam hechametz, lepikak eno niplat mehem al yede hagala bemayim rotechim, di"keboleo kak poleto", ukeli shennibla bo chametz al yede mashqeh — niplat mimmennu al yede hagala bemayim rotechim, abal kol keli shennibla bo hechametz al yede chom haesh bilbad shello al yede mashqeh — eno niplat mimmennu ella al yede chom haesh bilbad, dehaynu sheyyelabbeno baur yapeh yapeh ad sheyyihyu nitzotzot menattezin mimmennu, o ad shettashshir qelippato haelyona, sheaz bevadday nisrap kol haissur habbalua betoko.*[Veken haddin bekelim shennibla bahen shear issure tora o issure dibre soperim al yede haur bilbad, shetztzarik lelabbenam yapeh yapeh kashshiur shennitbaer. Ella shebbishar issurin en tzarik libbun ella keshennibla bahem debar issur, abal im nibla bahem al yede haur debar hetter veachar kak naasa issur, kegon shennitzla alehem basar lebaddo shehu hetter veachar kak nibla bahen chalab — hare hen niksharin al yede hagala. Veap al pi shettaam basar hannibla bahen al yede haur eno niplat mehem legamre al yede hagala, mikkol maqom oto muat taam basar habbalua meod betokam ad sheeno niplat mehem raq al yede haur qalush hu meod, veeno keday sheyyachul alayv shem chadash, dehaynu shem "basar bechalab", lepikak day lahem behagala kede lehaplit mehem iqqar taam habbasar im iqqar taam hechalab, shehen asurin mechamat shehen keday lehiqqare alehem shem "basar bechalab", vehen niplatin al yede hagala, lepi sheenan beluin meod, umotar taam habbasar im motar taam hechalab shehen beluin meod hare hen qelushin meod, veenan keday lihyot niqra alehen shem "basar bechalab", kevan shettaam habbasar haya qalush meod qodem shennibla bo hechalab — en shem chadash yakol lachul al taam qalush hazzeh. Mah sheen ken keshennitzla alehem chametz qodem happesach — en hagala moelet lahem lehakshiran lepesach. Ap al pi shehechametz beshaa shennibla bahem haya muttar baakila, mikkol maqom kevan shehaya alayv shem chametz — lo nipqa shem zeh gam mittaam haqqalush shennibla meod betokam al yede haur, ukeshemmaggia happesach mimmela neesar taam qalush hazzeh shebbetokam, kevan shekkebar niqra alayv shem chametz mishshaa shenniplat venitparesh mammashut hechametz shennitzla alehem]. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shekkol hakkelim shebbaleu chametz qodem happesach apillu al yede haur bilbad — hare hen niksharin al yede hagala, dekevan shebbishat beliatan baleu debar hetter veachar kak keshemmaggia zeman issuran kebar en haissur beayin ella hu balua betokan, lepikak heqellu lehakshiran al yede hagala bilbad. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Vaapillu bediabad shennishtammesh bechammin beotan kelim habbeluim mechametz al yede haur bilbad vehugalu qodem happesach velo libbenam baur yapeh yapeh kashshiur shennitbaer — hare chammin hallalu asurin bepesach. Ella im ken yesh hepsed merubbeh o meniat simchat yom tob, sheaz yesh lismok al sebara haacharona. Veken bemaqom sheyyesh od tzad acher lehaqel — yesh letzarep gam sebara haacharona velismok alehem lekattechilla lehakshir behagala et hakkelim habbeluim mechametz al yede haur, ukemo sheyyitbaer:

Mitzva min hammubchar lekol mi sheepshar lo sheyyiqneh lo sakkinim chadashim lepesach. Abal meiqqar haddin apillu otan sakkinim shemmishtammeshin bahem chametz bechammin kol hashshana — day lahem behagala lepesach. Veap al pi shessakkinim habbeluim mishshear issurin yesh omerim shetztzarik lelabbenam baur kede lehishtammesh bahen bechammin kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman qk"a, mikkol maqom kevan sheyyesh omerim sheapillu kelim habbeluim mechametz al yede haur bilbad day lahem behagala lepesach, vegam yesh omerim shessakkinim en lahem din kelim habbeluim al yede haur bilbad kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea sham, lepikak yesh lehattir lekattechilla lehakshir sakkinim ben gedolim uben qetannim al yede hagala bilbad. Vehu sheyyagilem berotechin bikli rishon, ukeli rishon niqra hakkeli shehirtichu bo hammayim etzel haesh. Apillu im akshav beshaa shemmagilin betoko eno omed etzel haesh — hare zeh niqra keli rishon, umagilin betoko kol keli hatztzarik hagala bikli rishon im hammayim shebbetoko hen adayin rotechin, dehaynu shemmaalin reticha kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tn"b:

Veqodem hagala tzarik lashup et hassakkinim bemashchezet o berechayim o bedabar acher hammesir et kol hachaludda shebbahen, veken shear kol hakkelim tzarik lehasir kol hachaludda vehattinnopet shebbahen qodem shemmagilan, shenneemar beparashat hagalat kele midyan "ak et hazzahab veku'", kelomar "raq et hazzahab vego'", dehaynu kesheen sham chaludda raq zahab bilbad — moelet hagala lehaplit habbalua, abal kesheyyesh sham chaludda o shear tinnopet — yesh lachosh shemma yesh sham mashshehu mimmammashut haissur beayin tachat hachaludda vehattinnopet, veen hagala moelet lemah shehu omed beeno veeno balua betok dopne hakkeli:

Veim eno yakol lehaabir hachaludda, o sheeno rotzeh litroach ulehaabirah — yasim gechalim boarot al meqom hachaludda veyashheh otam sham ad sheim yigga adam batztzad hashsheni shel hakkeli bammaqom shekkeneged hachaludda yihyeh hayyad soledet bo mechamat shennitlabben hakkeli min haggechalim, sheaz bevadday nisrap kol mammashut issur shettachat hachaludda. Vehaolam nahagu lehachamir lehashhot haggechalim kol kak al hachaludda ad sheyyihyeh qash o chut nisrap mitztzad hashsheni (dehaynu sheqqosherin qash o chut sebib hakkeli mitztzad hashsheni neged haggechalim sheal gabbe hachaludda umashheh et haggechalim kol kak ad sheyyisrop haqqash o hachut shekkenegdan batztzad hashsheni), veachar kak magilin et hakkeli. Veim lo asa ken qodem hagala — yaaseh ken achar hahagala:

Vekol zeh keshehachaludda hu batztzad happenimi shel hakkeli bemaqom shemmishtammeshin bo beqeba, abal im hu batztzad hachitzon shel hakkeli shello nishtammesh sham chametz, veap al pi shellipamim maggia tashmish hechametz gam mibbachutz, mikkol maqom kevan sherob happeamim en maggia tashmish hechametz ad lesham, lepikak en chosheshin shemma yesh sham mammashut hechametz beayin tachat hachaludda, veen tzarik lehaabirah kelal:

Vekol zeh bachaludda sheyyesh bah qetzat mammashut (sheqqorin rash"t), shekkesheggoredin otah mishsham yesh bah kamma aprurit, sheaz yesh lachosh im lo yegaredu otah mishsham shemma yesh tachteha mashshehu mammashut haissur beayin veeno nireh laayin mechamat shehachaludda mekassehu. Abal im en bachaludda mammashut kelal raq mareh bilbad, kemo shennimtza lipamim sheyyesh shacharut o admimut batztzad happenimi shel hakkeli, sheap im yegaredu otam lo yihyeh sham shum aprurit — en lachosh kelal shemma yesh sham mashshehu chametz sheeno nireh. Veken haddin beotan ketamim hannaasim bikle bedil (sheqqorin arad plaqy"n) sheen meakkebin et hahagala, kevan sheen bahem mammashut raq mareh bilbad:

Sakkin o echad mishshear kelim hatztzerikin hagala sheyyesh bo gumma o sedeq o neqeb sheeno yakol lechattet betokan lenaqqeran ulenaqqotan heteb — en hagala moelet lahem im hen bemaqom shemmishtammeshin bo beqeba, dehaynu mitztzad happenimi shel hakkeli, lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma yesh sham mashshehu mammashut hechametz beayin, veen hagala moelet lemah shehu beayin, lepikak tzarik lehanniach gechalim boarot al hassedeq vehaggumma veyashheh otam sham ad sheim yigga adam kenegdan batztzad hachitzon shel hakkeli yihyeh hayyad soledet bo, sheaz bevadday nisrap kol mammashut issur shebbetok hassedeq o haggumma. Vehaolam nahagu lehachamir lehashhot sham kol kak et haggechalim ad sheyyihyeh qash o chut nisrap batztzad hachitzon, veachar kak magilan. Veim lo asa ken qodem hahagala — yaaseh ken achar hahagala:

Lepikak otam sakkinim sheyyedotehen techubin tok bet yad vehen qebuin sham bemasmerim qetannim — en hagala moelet lahem, ki yesh gummot daqqot harbeh bimqom (sebib) hammasmerim. Veen tzarik lomar im gup habbet yad naasa mib' chalaqim medubbaqin veyesh revach meat benehem lehaknis lesham et hassakkin, sheal pi harob i epshar lenaqqer sham heteb shello yihyeh shum tinnopet dabuq sham, veen hagala moelet ella likli zak venaqi kemo shennitbaer. Veken im yad hassakkin debuqa bebet yad al yede debeq — en hagala moelet lah, dekevan shehaddebeq mitqalqel bemayim rotechin — yesh lachosh shemma yachus al haddebeq velo yartiach et hammayim yapeh yapeh. Veken im habbet yad hi asuya miqqeren, veken shear kol hakkelim haasuyin miqqeren — en hagala moelet lahen, shehaqqeren mitqalqel bemayim rotechin, veyesh lachosh shemma yachus alayv:

Vekol zeh bebet yad shel sakkin shemmishtammeshin chametz begup hassakkin verob happeamim maggia tashmish hechametz gam behabbet yad shel sakkin, abal shear kol hakkelim sheyyesh bidotehen gummot usedaqim vachaludda — en tzarik lenaqqeran kelal. Vaapillu im lo higil kelal et hayyadot utechaban bepesach letok hattabshil — hare zeh muttar baakila, kevan sheen derek lehishtammesh chametz bidot hakkelim. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tzarik lehagil gam et hayyadot al yede eruy mikkeli rishon lekol happachot, lepi shellipamim keshemmedichin et hakkelim millikluk chametz shebbahen betok mayim chammin nibla qetzat millikluk hechametz letok hayyadot:

Veim lo higil kelal apillu et gup hakkeli vetachab et yad hakkeli letok hattabshil — yesh oserin et hattabshil im hakkeli veyado hen shel mattakot, lepi shekkeshennishtammesh chametz bechammin begup hakkeli nibla hechametz gam beyad hakkeli, shekkol matteket shecham miqtzato cham kullo, ukemo shennibla hechametz behayyad al yede gup hakkeli kak hu niplat mimmennu al yede gup hakkeli, abal keshello higil apillu et gup hakkeli — hare nishara beliat hechametz betok hayyad, veniplat mimmennu letok hattabshil. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheap al pi shekkol matteket shecham miqtzato cham kullo, ap al pi ken habbalua shebbemiqtzato eno mitpashshet bekullo al yede chom zeh. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom hepsed merubbeh o bimqom meniat simchat yom tob:

Hannadan shel sakkinim shemmaknisin letoko sakkin shel chametz kol hashshana — en hagala moelet lo lehakshiro lehaknis letoko sakkin shel pesach, lepi shei epshar lenaqqero ulenaqqoto heteb min hechametz beayin shennidbaq bo, ki amoq amoq hu mi yimtzaennu, ella im ken poteach et hattepirot umegordo yapeh yapeh (sheaz apillu hagala en tzarik):

Chatzuba (sheqqorin dariipos) vehu keli sheyyesh lo g' raglayim umaamidin aleha qedera o machabat battannur al haur kol hashshana, im rotzeh lehishtammesh bah bepesach — tzarik lelabbenah baur, lepi shellipamim nishpak aleha issa venibla bah taam chametz al yede haur shello al yede mashqeh:

Echad kele matteket veechad kele etz veechad kele gelalim ukele abanim ukele adama (perush kele cheres shello nitzrepu bekibshan ella nityabbeshu bachamma), veechad kele etzem (chutz miqqeren, kemo shennitbaer lemala). Umah sheqqorin pary"l mvt"r shennishtammesh bahen chametz al yede mashqin chammin, kederek shennishtammesh bahen kak tzarik lehakshiran al yede hagala. Ketzad? Kelim shennishtammesh venibla bahen chametz kol hashshana al yede chom keli rishon, kegon qederot veilpasin veyorot, veken kap shehu meyuchad lehagis bo haqqedera keshehi etzel haesh, o apillu leachar sheheebirah min haesh ella shehattabshil betokah cham bikde shehayyad soledet bo, veken kap shehu meyuchad lehotzi bo hattabshil mehaqqedera letok haqqeara, kol ellu vekayyotze bahen shedderek lehishtammesh bahen chametz kol hashshana al yede chom keli rishon — tzarik lehagilan betok keli rishon roteach, veal derek sheyyitbaer besiman tn"b. Veniqra keli rishon apillu leachar sheheebiruhu min haesh, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veyesh omerim shekkol keli shennishtammesh bo issur al yede chom keli rishon keshehaya hakkeli rishon etzel haesh — tzarik lehagilo gam ken betok keli rishon haomed etzel haesh, di"keboleo kak poleto". Ulekattechilla yesh lehachamir velachosh ledibrehem bishar issurim, abal bechametz apillu lekattechilla yesh lismok al sebara harishona, shehare yesh omerim sheapillu kelim shennishtammesh bahen chametz al yede haur bilbad moelet lahem hagala bikli rishon leachar sheheebiruhu min haesh. Veen tzarik lomar keshemmagil keli habbalua mibbasar vechalab, shelledibre hakkol yakol lehagilo bikli rishon leachar sheheebiruhu min haesh, ap al pi shettaam habbasar vehechalab nibleu bo al yede haur, im lo nibleu bo bebat achat ella bazeh achar zeh, mittaam shennitbaer lemala:

Vekelim shennishtammeshu bahem chametz al yede eruy mikkeli rishon, kegon qearot en tzarik lehagilan betok keli rishon, ella day lahem sheyyearu alehem rotechin mikkeli rishon kederek tashmishan. (Veap al pi shellipamim kopin qeara al gabbe ilpas sheetzel haesh veoleh hahebel mehattabshil shebbailpas venibla behaqqeara, venimtza shennibla bah chametz lipamim al yede chom keli rishon, mikkol maqom kevan sherob tashmish haqqearot hu learot letokan mikkeli rishon — hare niksharin gam ken al yede eruy mikkeli rishon, sheanu holekim bekol keli achar rob tashmisho). Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim: kevan shellipamim mishtammeshin chametz biqarot al yede chom keli rishon — tzarik lehagilan gam ken betok keli rishon, ki ek toil hagalat eruy mikkeli rishon lehaplit min haqqeara mah shebbalua bah lipamim al yede chom keli rishon atzmo:

Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir lekattechilla kassebara haacharona. Veken nohagin, veen leshannot. Veim haqqeara hi gedola shei epshar lo lehagilah betok keli rishon — yitten aleha eben melubban viareh aleha mayim rotechin min keli rishon, veyaabir aleha haeben al pene haqqeara, kede sheyyartiach et kol hammayim sheera aleha veyihyeh chummam kol kak gadol kechom keli rishon. Veken yaaseh bekol hatztzarik hagala bikli rishon. Abal keli qatan sheyyakol lehakniso betok keli rishon, veken qearot qetannot — en lehagilan al yede eruy veeben melubban, lepi sheyyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shehagala kazo enah chashuba kehagala betok keli rishon. Vaapillu qeara gedola, im yesh lah oganin ubelitot keen kaptorim uperachim — en lah taqqana al yede eruy veeben melubban, shei epshar lehaabir haeben al pene kullah:

Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad shekkebar higil et haqqearot vekayyotze bahen al yede eruy mikkeli rishon bilbad beli eben melubban vehishtammesh bahen bepesach bechammin — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, umuttar leekol chammin hallalu betok happesach. Vehu shehigilan al yede eruy mikkeli rishon atzmo, o shehiknis keli reqan letok keli rishon roteach veachar shennishabu hammayim letok hakkeli reqan hishha meat et hakkeli reqan betok hakkeli rishon ad shehammayim shennishabu letoko heelu reticha betoko veachar kak hotzio mittok hakkeli rishon veera mimmennu al haqqearot, sheddin eruy zeh keeruy keli rishon atzmo. (Dekevan shekkeli zeh shaha betok hakkeli rishon ad shehammayim shennishabu letoko heelu reticha, bevadday nitchammemu dopne keli zeh chom gadol, veap leachar shehotzio im hammayim shebbetoko mittok hakkeli rishon — hare dapnotayv maamidin et chom hammayim shebbetoko, ulepikak din keli zeh kedin keli rishon atzmo). Abal im lo shaha betok hakkeli rishon kashshiur hazzeh — yesh lehistappeq bo im dino kikli rishon atzmo o lav, veholekin bo lehachamir, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"z. Lepikak im eru meharotechin shebbetoko al qearot shennishtammesh bahen al yede eruy mikkeli rishon atzmo — lo olta lahem hagala, veoserin et hachammin shennishtammeshu bahen bepesach:

Vaapillu im era al haqqeara mikkeli rishon atzmo lo olta lahem hagala, ella im ken nizhar shello yipsoq haqqilluach min hakkeli rishon qodem shennaga haqqilluach begup haqqeara, shekkol qilluach shennipsaq veeno mechubbar likli rishon — hare nitqarer venitmaet chummo mechom qilluach shehu mechubbar likli rishon, lepikak en qilluach zeh maplit min haqqeara mah shennibla bah al yede qilluach hamchubbar lehakkeli rishon shehu meqalleach mimmennu:

Abal keshemmagil al yede eben melubban — en nohagin lizzaher bekol zeh, sheap shennipsaq haqqilluach qodem shemmaggia lehaqqeara venitqarer meat hare hu chozer umartiach al yede eben hamlubban. Veken im apillu eno meareh al haqqeara mehakkeli rishon atzmo, ella meareh mehakkeli rishon likli acher umeoto keli meareh al haqqeara — hare zeh muttar, sheeben hamlubban hu martiach et hammayim umechammem otam chom gadol kechom keli rishon. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tob lehachamir velizzaher bekol zeh ap keshemmagil al yede eben melubban, shehare yesh omerim sheeben hamlubban en lo koach lehartiach et hammayim ulechammem otam chom gadol kechom keli rishon:

Vekol zeh keshehaqqeara enah bat yomah mittashmish keli rishon, dehaynu shello kapuha al ilpas roteach betok meet leet lehagala zo, shekkol mah shennibla bah al yede keli rishon qodem meet leet lehagala zo hu noten taam lipgam, veen tzarik lehagilah ulehaplitah kelal min haqqeara min hattora ella middibre soperim, vachakamim heqellu lelek achar rob tashmish hakkeli, lepi sebara harishona. Abal im hi bat yomah mittashmish keli rishon — tzarik lehagilah betok keli rishon mammash ledibre hakkol. Vaapillu bediabad oseret hachammin shennishtammeshu bah betok meet leet letashmish keli rishon, im higilah al yede eruy belo eben melubban:

Vekelim shennishtammesh venibla bahen chametz kol hashshana al yede chom keli sheni, kegon kappot sheenan meyuchadin lehagis haqqedera o lehotzi bahen tabshil mehaqqedera, ella rob tashmish hamyuchad lahem hu leekol bahem mehaqqeara, shehi niqret keli sheni (leachar shennipsaq haqqilluach mehakkeli rishon) — hare hen niksharin al yede hagala bikli sheni, dehaynu sheyyeareh rotechin mikkeli rishon letok keli sheni, veyasim hakkappot betok harotechin shebbikli sheni. Ulehaomerim sheen holekim bekelim achar rob tashmishan — tzarik lehagil kol kap vekap betok keli rishon, shellipamim megisin bo haqqedera o motziin bo tabshil mehaqqedera. Veken nohagin, veen leshannot:

Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad apillu lo higil kelal et hakkappot utechaban bepesach letok keli rishon — yesh lehattiro baakila im yesh hepsed merubbeh o meniat simchat yom tob, lepi sheyyesh lismok al sebara harishona sheholekin bekol keli achar rob tashmisho, veal dibre haomerim shekkol hakkelim shennibla bahem issur al yede chom keli sheni — en tzarik hagala kelal, lepi shechom keli sheni en bo koach lehablia kelal. Umikkol maqom, en lehaqel ella kesheen hakkappot bene yoman, sheaz yesh lismok al haomerim shennoten taam lipgam muttar ap bepesach, ki ken iqqar. Abal im hen bene yoman mibbeliat chametz — en lehaqel:

Bammeh debarim amurim bechom keli sheni atzmo, dehaynu hakkappot shebbaleu chametz al yede chom keli sheni, dehaynu betok haqqeara shehu keli sheni, abal eruy mikkeli sheni, kegon roteb cham shehayyad soledet bo shel chametz shebbetok haqqeara shennishpak al debar hetter bepesach — en lehachamir bo, veday lo bahadacha ap al pi sheen kan noten taam lipgam. Veen tzarik lomar shechom keli shelishi urebii eno oser bepesach ap shehayyad soledet bo. Umikkol maqom, en lehaqel bazeh ella im ken yesh hepsed merubbeh o meniat simchat yom tob, kevan sheyyesh machamirin ap bishar issurim bekol chom shehayyad soledet bo ap shehu keli shelishi urebii, sheap sheen lo koach lebashshel mikkol maqom yesh lo koach lehablia ulehaplit, im ken al kol panim bechametz bepesach yesh linhog kemotam, shehare yesh machamirin bechametz bepesach apillu betzonen, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"z:

Sallim shemmolechim bahem basar kol hashshana bemelach shello nibdaq mechametz (ben sallim menuqqabim shemmolechin bahen basar liqdera lehakshiro middamo uben sallim sheenan menuqqabin shemmolechin bahem habbasar leachar shehikshiruhu middamo), im rotzeh limloach bahen basar lepesach — tob lehachamir ulehagilan al yede eruy mikkeli rishon lehaplit mehem taam perur chametz mashshehu shebben hammelach shennibla bahen al yede melichat habbasar betokam kol hashshana, shettaam mashshehu zeh habbalua betok gup hassal eno mitbattel betokam beshishshim, mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"t. Umikkol maqom, im lo higilan kelal umalach bahen basar bepesach — muttar leekol basar zeh bepesach, apillu im yadua lo shennibla bahen chametz harbeh peamim al yede melicha o al yede chamme haur, ap al pi ken muttar leekol basar zeh bepesach, sheen hammelach maplit mah shebbalua betok kelim, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Machabat shemmetaggenin bah issat chametz kol hashshana beshemen o beshumman — yesh omerim shetztzerika libbun gamur kedino lehishtammesh bah bepesach, lepi shellipamim nisrap venikleh hashshemen o hashshumman shettachat kol haissa o shettachat miqtzatah venibla bah taam haissa bammachabat al yede haur bilbad shello al yede mashqeh, vetaam zeh eno niplat mimmenna al yede hagala ella al yede libbun, di"keboleo kak poleto". Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheim banu lachosh lazeh im ken kol qederot shel mattakot shemmebashshel bahen chametz kol hashshana lo toil lahen hagala, ki lipamim maqdiach haroteb venechsar harbeh ad shehattabshil nisrap venidbaq ledopne hakkeli, vehattaam sheen anu chosheshim lazeh lepi sheap al pi shehattabshil nisrap venidbaq ledopne hakkeli, mikkol maqom lachluchit mashqeh yesh betoko ubipnimiyyuto, velo nityabbesh ella tzad hachitzon sheetzel dopen haqqedera, vegam sham yesh qetzat lachluchit mashqeh ella shehu yabesh, veen haqqedera niqret bishbil kak "tashmishah al yede haur" lehatzrikah libbun, vehu haddin vehu hattaam lemachabat shemmetaggenin bah. Abal machabat sheapu bah issa, ap al pi shemmashach et hammachabat beshemen o beshumman tachat haissa kede shello tissarep — en zeh niqra tiggun ella apiyya, kevan sheen haissa rocheshet beshemen o beshumman, vahare nibla bah hechametz al yede haur bilbad, utzerika libbun gamur kedino, veken haddin beagganot sheopin bahen ugot:

Uleinyan halaka, bemachabat habbalua mishshear issurin — yesh lehachamir lekattechilla kassebara harishona. Abal machabat habbalua mechametz — yesh lehaqel kassebara haacharona, shehare yesh omerim shekkol hakkelim apillu tashmishan al yede haur bilbad day lahem behagala lepesach. Veim hammachabat hi arukka vei epshar lehaknisah kullah keachat betok keli rishon — yaknis chetzyah vehopekah umaknis chetzyah haacheret. Veim hi arukka beyoter sheap im yaknisenna chatzain yishshaer beemtzaitah maqom shello nigal — yelabben oto maqom baur, o yasim alayv gechalim ad sheim yigga adam batztzad hachitzon keneged oto maqom yihyeh hayyad soledet bo, veken yaaseh bishar kol hakkelim shehen arukkin beyoter:

Kol keli sheyyesh bo telay (im hattelay hu betzad penimi shel hakkeli) — eno nikshar behagala ad sheyyasir et hattelay qodem hahagala, lepi shehabbalua shebboobi hakkotel tachat hattelay eno niplat legamre min hakkeli al yede hagala, shehattelay meakkeb al harotechim shebbetok hakkeli veen bahem koach lehaplit habbalua shemmeeber lattelay (vaapillu im maknis kol hakkeli letok rotechin venimtza sheharotechin maggiin gam batztzad hachitzon shel hakkeli sheen sham telay, ap al pi ken en bahen koach lehaplit habbalua mishsham, lepi she"keboleo kak poleto", vehaissur nibla betzad hakkeli mitztzad happenimi shello sheshsham hu derek tashmisho, vetzarik lehaplit haissur gam ken mitztzad happenimi shel hakkeli al yede harotechin shebbetok hakkeli, vekevan sheyyesh sham telay en koach barotechin shebbetok hakkeli lehaplit kol haissur shemmeeber lattelay) bepaam achat, ella niplat hu meat meat, veal yede hagala zo niplat meat, ukesheyyishtammeshu bo bepesach yihyeh chozer veniplat meat, ulepikak en lo taqqana ella sheyyelabben meqom hattelay libbun gamur kedino, shehaesh sorep et kol habbalua ap shemmeeber lattelay shebbetok hakkeli. Veim hu keli shel etz — en lo taqqana ad sheyyasir hattelay qodem hahagala. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheqqodma beliat haissur bakkeli lehattelay, dehaynu sheqqodem shessamu hattelay bakkeli kebar nishtammesh venibla issur bakkeli bimqom hattelay, veoto balua keshemmesimin alayv telay eno niplat legamre min hakkeli al yede hagala, abal im qadam hattelay libliat haissur bakkeli, dehaynu shessamu hattelay bakkeli keshehaya hakkeli chadash shello nibla bo issur adayin, o apillu nibla bo issur ella shehigilo vehikshiro qodem shessamu bo et hattelay veachar kak chazar venishtammesh bo issur, veken apillu im lo higilo ad leachar simat hattelay ella shebbeshaa shehigilo libben et meqom hattelay kedino veachar kak chazar venishtammesh venibla bo issur — kol zeh niqra "qadam hattelay libliat haissur bakkeli", vahare hu nikshar al yede hagala. Veap habbalua shettachat hattelay niplat al yede hagala zo, kevan shehu nibla sham keshehaya hattelay kebar sham mudbaq bakkeli — hare hu niplat gam ken keshehattelay mudbaq bakkeli, di"keboleo kak poleto". Umikkol maqom, im en hattelay mudbaq lakkeli yapeh ella yesh sham qetzat sedeq vegumma beinyan sheyyesh lachosh shemma niknas sham tachat hattelay qetzat mashshehu mimmammashut haissur — tzarik lehanniach gechalim boarot al hattelay (veyashheh otam ad sheim yigga adam batztzad hachitzon keneged oto maqom yihyeh hayyad soledet bo, o ad sheim yanniach sham qash o chut yihyu nisrapin lepi hamminhag shennitbaer lemala) kede sheyyisrop mammashut haissur shettachtayv im yeshno sham. O yarchib hassedeq harbeh kol kak ad sheyyukal lenaqqer betoko yapeh ulehotzi kol mah shebbetoko. Veyesh omerim sheapillu im qodma beliat issur lehattelay hare hu nikshar behagala, shehahagala mapletet ap habbalua shemmeeber lattelay, ella sheim qadam tashmish haissur bakkeli lehattelay, vehattelay hu bemaqom shemmishtammeshin bo beqeba, dehaynu mitztzad happenimi shel hakkeli — anu chosheshin shemma nishar mashshehu mammashut hechametz bakkeli tachat hattelay, ulepikak ap im hu mudbaq yapeh lehakkeli tzarik lehanniach gechalim al hattelay kede sheyyisrop mammashut haissur shettachtayv, o yagbihennu meat beinyan sheyyukal lenaqqer tachtayv yapeh. Abal im qadam hattelay libliat haissur bakkeli — en tzarik lehanniach alayv gechalim, ella im ken eno mudbaq yapeh lehakkeli. Uleinyan pesaq halaka — yesh lehaqel kassebara haacharona. Umikkol maqom, bemaqom sheepshar tob lachosh lassebara harishona:

Vekol zeh bitlay shehu keen tas umedubbaq lakkeli al yede masmerim kemo shehu derek lehimmatze beyorot ubeilpasin, abal telay shello nidbaq bakkeli al yede masmerim ella al yede haesh kemo shehu derek laasot bikle bedil shenniqqebu shemmattipin alehem bedil shennittak baesh — hare hem niksharim behagala, veen tzarik lehanniach gechalim al hattelay ap im qodma beliat haissur bakkeli, lepi sheal yede chom habbedil nisrap kol mammashut haissur shettachtayv im yeshno sham, vegam habbalua shemmeeber lattelay niplat behagala, veen hattelay meakkeb kelal, kevan sheeno mudbaq lakkeli al yede masmerim ella al yede chom haesh — hare naasa hakkol gup echad ukeli echad mammash. Veen tzarik lomar im beet simat hattelay libben et meqom hattelay baur kemo shehu derek laasot bikle barzel shenniqqebu shemmesimin chatikat barzel al hanneqeb veal yede haesh mitchabberet chatika zo legup hakkeli venaasa hakkol gup echad, sheaz en tzarik lehagil kelal et hammaqom shennitlabben baur im lo nishtammesh bo issur achar kak:

Roshem shehaummanim osim betok hakkeli lehakkir maaseh yedehem — hare hu nikshar behagala, meachar shennaasa keshehakkeli haya chadash — hare qadam hu libliat haissur bakkeli u"keboleo kak poleto". Ubilbad sheyyenaqqer oto heteb o yanniach alayv gechalim:

Kissuy shel barzel shemmekassim bo haqqedera kol hashshana — tzarik hagala bikli rishon, dekevan shehu mazzia mechom hattabshil shebbaqqedera — hare nibla bo hechametz al yede chom keli rishon, u"keboleo kak poleto". Veim lo higilo veshakach vesamo bepesach al haqqedera sheyyesh bah tabshil roteach, im nizkar miyyad vehesiro min haqqedera veraa shehu yabesh adayin shello hitchil lehazzia mechom hattabshil shebbaqqedera — hare hattabshil muttar apillu baakila im lo naga bo hakkissuy, vegam haqqedera mutteret ap al pi shennaga bah hakkissuy, sheen issur yotze mikkeli likli belo roteb kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"h. Abal im shaha hakkissuy meat al haqqedera beinyan sheyyesh lachosh shemma kebar hitchil tzad happenimi shel hakkissuy lehazzia ad shehayyad soledet bo bezea zo vechazar venityabbesh mechamat chom, veen tzarik lomar im keshemmesir hakkissuy mehaqqedera roeh bo qetzat lachluchit shehayyad soledet bo shehizzia mechom hattabshil shebbaqqedera — hare hattabshil vehaqqedera asurin (im hakkissuy hu ben yomo, o apillu eno ben yomo lepi minhag medinot ellu sheoserin noten taam lipgam bepesach, o lepi minhag qetzat meqomot shemmachamirim bekissuy qedera apillu bishar issurin veoserin ap sheeno ben yomo kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"g ayyen sham), lepi shehahebel haoleh mehattabshil lehakkissuy hu mechabber et zeat hakkissuy im hattabshil, venaasa keillu nitorba hazzea battabshil, vezea zo yesh bah taam chametz shehu niplat min hakkissuy keshehu mazzia:

Kissuy shel barzel shemmesimin al charara keshenneepet al hakkira — tzarik lelabbeno libbun gamur kedino, lepi shebberob happeamim hu nogea begup hacharara shettachtayv ubolea mimmenna taam hechametz shello al yede mashqeh ella al yede chom haesh bilbad:

Kol hakkelim apillu shel cheres shennishtammesh bahen chametz kol hashshana betzonen — muttar lehishtammesh [bahen] matztza bepesach apillu bechammin, dekevan shello nishtammeshu bahem ella betzonen — lo baleu kelum, veday lahem bahadacha lehaabir mah sheddabuq beayin ledopne hakkeli. Chutz mibbet seor, dehaynu keli shehaishsha shora (umannachat) bo et hasseor litteno baissa, upeamim shehasseor shoheh harbeh beoto keli umechamat chariputo nibla tamo beoto keli apillu betzonen, ulepikak asur lehishtammesh bo matztza bechammin. Abal betzonen muttar, kegon litten betokah matztza apuya tzonenet, o shear dabar tzonen apillu lach derek aray umiqreh (abal en lehishtammesh bo biqbiut ki im likbisa velirchitza kemo shennitbaer besiman t"n), shehatztzonen apillu hu lach eno maplit mah shebbalua betok hakkeli, ella im ken shoheh betoko meet leet kemo shennitbaer. Abal asur lalush betoko matztza ap al pi shettashmish betzonen hu, mikkol maqom reach hechametz habbalua bakkeli gorem lemaher chimmutz haissa hannillosha betoko qodem hagala. Abal leachar hagala muttar lehishtammesh bo apillu bechammin, shehahagala mapletet kol taam vereach hechametz habbalua bakkeli, ella im ken hu shel cheres, sheen hagala moelet lo lehishtammesh bo bechammin o lalush betoko. Veakshav baddorot haacharonim nahagu kol yisrael shello lehishtammesh kelal bepesach bikle cheres ki im bachadashim, abal kele cheres hayshanim apillu lo nishtammesh bahen chametz meolam ki im betzonen — en mishtammeshin bahem bepesach apillu betzonen:

Ubet charoset, dehaynu keli shennotenin bo chometz ushear dabar sheyyesh bo qiyyuha vachariput, uregilin litten betokah qemach vehu mitchammetz mechamat haqqiyyuha, veasuy letabbel bo basar, umechamat chariput hacharoset (perush kol debar qiyyuha niqra charoset) nibla gam taam hechametz betok hakkeli, ulepikak dino kedin bet seor, sheen mishtammeshin bo bechammin velo lashin betoko ella leachar hagala im eno keli cheres. Veyesh omerim sheen hagala moelet kelum lebet seor ubet charoset, hoil vechimmutzan qasheh, shennibla bahen al yede chariput hacharoset o hasseor, lepikak en lo taqqana. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona, shehabbelia shemmechamat hachariput enah gedola vachazaqa mehabbalua shemmechamat chamme haur, shehi nipletet al yede hagala berotechin, vekol shekken habbelia betzonen shemmechamat hachariput. Umikkol maqom, hamminhag bimdinot ellu lehachamir kassebara haacharona bemaqom sheepshar, kegon shehu keli shel barzel o nechoshet vekayyotze bahem sheepshar lelabbeno baur — machamirin lelabbeno libbun qal, dehaynu sheyyehe qash o chut nisrap alayv mibbachutz. Abal keli charoset shel bedil o shel etz shei epshar lelabbeno — day lo behagala bikli rishon. Abal bet seor dino kishar kol kele hallisha, shennohagin lehachamir shello lehishtammesh bahem bepesach apillu al yede hagala kemo sheyyitbaer:

Medoka shergilin laduk betokah shumim ushear debarim charipim im perure lechem chametz — hare dino kebet charoset. Veim hu shel bedil o shel etz — day lahem behagala bikli rishon. Ella sheim hi shel etz — yesh leqallepah bikli ummanut lehachaliqah qodem hagala, lepi shemmetzuyin bah gummot ubeqaim. Veim hi gedola meod sheeno yakol lehaknisah letok keli rishon lehagilah — yemalleenna mayim rotechin veyaknis betokah eben melubban ad sheyyigberu hammayim veyartichu veyaalu vikassu al kol sepatah, dekevan shehirtichu hammayim mechamat haeben hamlubban shebbetokam — hare chumman gadol kechom keli rishon. (Abal shear kol hakkelim haggedolim sheenan shel etz ubedil — tob sheyyartiach mayim bahen atzman, veyaaseh kemo sheyyitbaer besop siman tn"b, veal yeareh letoko rotechin mikkeli rishon acher veeben melubban, lepi sheyyesh omerim shehaeben hamlubban en lo koach lechammem hammayim chom gadol kechom keli rishon, ulepikak en zo hagala chashuba kehagalat keli rishon). Veim hi shel barzel — nohagin lelabbenah libbun qal:

Abal medokot shellanu shelleolam en dakin bahem perure lechem velo shear chametz, apillu hi shel barzel unechoshet — en tzarik lelabbenah kelal. Veap lehagilah en tzarik meiqqar haddin, ella shellepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma napal letokah perur chametz paam achat veachar kak daku bah tablin charipim veniddak gam happerur chametz immahem umechamat chariputam nibla gam hu immahem betok hamdoka, lepikak tob lehachamir ulehagilah betok keli rishon. Veim daku bah tablin bepesach belo hagala unetanam battabshil — muttar leekol hattabshil bepesach im hattablin shebbetokah, dekevan shebbammedokot shellanu en bahen ella chashash shemma napal letokah perur chametz, ubishbil chashash zeh en leesor bediabad, shemmeiqqar haddin en lachosh kelal lazeh, sheen machaziqin issur missapeq kammeboar beyoreh dea siman l"t. (Umikkol maqom, im adayin lo netanam battabshil — tob shello yittenem battabshil ad leachar happesach, dekevan sheepshar lehatzniam ad leachar happesach — hare zeh lekattechilla. Abal im qodem happesach daku bah tablin belo hagala — muttar leoklam bepesach, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tm"z ayyen sham):

Areba shellashin bah umashhin bah haissa ad shettachmitz — hare hi kebet seor shebbolea apillu betzonen. Ulepikak en lashin bah matztza ad sheyyagilenna bikli rishon. Veken haddap sheorekin alayv hechametz kol hashshana bitdirut — dino kebet seor, veen orekin alayv matztza ad sheyyagilennu bikli rishon. (Abal hashshulchanot sheen orekin alehem chametz bitdirut ella lipraqim — en dinam kebet seor, kemo sheyyitbaer). Vaapillu im rotzeh leqallepo bikli ummanut — en moil lo velo lishar kele etz hatztzarik hagala, lepi shehahagala mapletet mimmennu kol haggiul habbalua bekol obyo meeber leeber, mah sheen ken qillup bikli ummanut:

Ubimdinot ellu nohagin shello lalush velaarok bedappim vaarebot shel kol hashshana apillu al yede hagala, lepi shechosheshim ledibre haomerim sheen hagala moelet lebet seor, veod shemmin hassetam i epshar lenaqqeram heteb shello yihyeh shum mashshehu chametz dabuq bahen beayin. Vaapillu im rotzeh leqallepan ulehachaliqan bikli ummanut ulehagilan achar kak — en moil lahem velo lishar kol hakkelim sheshshimmeshu baissa, kegon atze megalgelin vekayyotze bahen, veen leshannot hamminhag. (Veim lo qillepan veyesh bahen beqiim vacharitzim — tob letucham betit o lemokram lenokri qodem happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b). Veim mesim sadin baareba o al haddap leachar shehigil — muttar lehanniach matztzot chammot al hassadin ben sheqqillepan ben shello qillepan, lepi shehassadin mapsiq ben hammatztzot uben perure hechametz shebbetok haggummot ubeqaim. Abal matztza tzonenet muttar lehanniach al hassadin derek aray umiqreh apillu qodem shehigilan. Abal en lalush velaarok al hassadin, kevan shekkobed hallisha vehaarika maggia el gup haareba vehaddap — hare zeh kelash veorek al haareba vehaddap atzmam, sheyyesh kan issur meiqqar haddin im lo higilan. Veap im higilan — en lehaqel baddabar lepi hamminhag shennitbaer:

Kol hakkelim sheshshimmeshu beqemach kol hashshana — apillu lehagilan en tzarik meiqqar haddin, kedin kelim shennishtammesh bahem chametz betzonen shemmuttar lehishtammesh bahem bepesach apillu bechammin belo hagala. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar lalush bahem o lehishtammesh bahem shear tashmishe tzonen, raq sheyyizzaher lahadicham uleshapshepam bemayim yapeh yapeh qodem sheyyishtammesh bahem. Vaapillu hannapa sheriqqedu bah qemach shel chametz kol hashshana, sheap shehi kullah melea neqabim vacharitzim — ap al pi ken muttar leraqqed bah qemach bepesach belo hagala. Ella shetztzarik ledaqdeq bah meod lenaqqotah min haqqemach shel chametz haddabuq venisrak beniqbe arigat hannapa vehaddabuq baetz hamsabbeb et haariga, veyadiach vishapshep otam bemayim yapeh yapeh. Vehu haddin lishar kol kele haqqemach ukele hallisha, shehashshipshup bahem iqqar gadol:

Vekol zeh meiqqar haddin, abal kebar nahagu bimdinot ellu shello lehishtammesh bikli etz shehaya bo qemach tamid apillu al yede hadacha veshipshup vehagala, shechosheshin shemma nishar mashshehu qemach dabuq bakkeli. Abal im qodem happesach hecheziq bo mayim ezeh zeman — nohagin lehishtammesh bo al yede hagala, shehammayim sheshshahu betoko hedichu veheebiru kol hechametz haddabuq bo. Veken keli etz shehaya bo mashqeh heasuy mimme subbin (sheqqorin barsh"t bimdinot ruseya) — en mishtammeshin bo apillu al yede hadacha veshipshup vehagala, ella im ken hecheziqu bo mayim ezeh zeman. Abal im hu keli nechoshet o bedil o shear mine mattakot — nohagin lehishtammesh bahem al yede hagala ap shello hecheziqu bo mayim, lepi shehu yakol lehaabir hechametz mehem al yede hadacha veshipshup:

Veken nohagin shello lehishtammesh besallim arugim shehaya munnach bahem pat o shear chametz vadday (abal im nishtammesh bahem dabar sheen bo ella chashash chametz, kegon shemmalach bahem basar bemelach shello nibdaq mechametz — moelet lahem hagala kemo shennitbaer lemala), apillu nishru bemayim yamim rabbim, lepi shechosheshin shemma nishar perur chametz ben niqbe haariga, ulekak apillu hagala enah moelet lahem lehishtammesh bahen bechammin o apillu betzonen belo perisat sadin betokam. (Abal im paras sadin betokam — muttar lehanniach matztza tzonenet al hassadin qodem happesach. Abal betok happesach tob shello lehishtammesh bahem kelal, ella yimkerem lenokri o yetuchem betit qodem happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b ayyen sham):

Veken kol kayyotze bazeh mishshear kelim hannequbim, kegon hakkis shel rechayim o hannapa, nohagin shello lehishtammesh bahem apillu al yede hadacha veshipshup vehagala. Vaapillu napa chadasha shehitchilu lenappot bah qemach lepesach venapal aleha mayim apillu al miqtzatah — en lah taqqana lehishtammesh bah od apillu al yede hagala, ella tzarik liqnot napa acheret chadasha:

Veim abar veriqqed qemach lepesach benapa shel chametz al yede hadacha veshipshup belo hagala, apillu riqqedo betok happesach — hare zeh muttar apillu baakila, shebbediabad maamidin al iqqar haddin. Veken im hu sheat haddechaq kegon shei epshar limtzo napa chadasha, vegam i epshar lalush belo riqqud haqqemach, kegon sheen harechayim tochanot yapeh veim lo yeraqqedu haqqemach yimtzeu behaissa chittim sheburot — hare zeh kediabad, umaamidin al iqqar haddin, umuttar lenappot benapa yeshana al yede shipshup vehagala:

Veken nohagin shello lehishtammesh bemorag charutz (sheqqorin rib aiizan) apillu al yede hadacha vehagala, ella im ken libbeno baur. Vaapillu bediabad shehigilo vehishtammesh bo betok happesach — yesh leesor baakila mah shennishtammesh bo, lepi shellipamim megorerin alayv lechem chametz, vei epshar shello nishtayyer perur mashshehu betok neqabayv. Vegam hattamka (sheqqorin qry"n) sheggareru alayv kol hashshana nechtak besakkin shel chametz, vehattamka hu dabar charip, ayyen siman tm"z. Abal mah shennishtammesh bo qodem happesach, ap im nitareb betoko perur chametz — hare hu mitbattel betoko beshishshim (umuttar leoklo beereb pesach ad hallayla, abal keshehiggia hallayla — hare happerur chozer veneor, veoser bemashshehu, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tas"[v]). Din hassaqqim shel qemach — yitbaer besiman tn"g ayyen sham:

Harachat (sheqqorin shvby"l) shemmaknisin bah hallechem lattannur umotziin bah min hattannur — enah niksheret al yede hagala, lepi shehi bolaat min hechametz al yede chom haur bilbad beli shum mashqeh, ulepikak tzarik lelabbenah baur libbun gamur kedino — "keboleo kak poleto". Veim hi shel etz — en lah taqqana, vetzarik liqnot chadasha. Vaapillu im rotzeh liqlop hayshana bikli ummanut ulehagilah achar kak — en moil kelum. Abal im rotzeh lehishtammesh berachat shel pesach heabar, im yadua lo shello nishtammesh bah chametz kol hashshana shehitznia otah bemaqom meyuchad venizhar leshomrah lappesach habba — en tzarik apillu lehagilah im beshaa sheggamar lehishtammesh bah bepesach heabar nizhar lenaqqerah heteb shello yihyeh mashshehu batzeq dabuq bah, vegam akshav beshaa sherotzeh lehishtammesh bah roeh otah shehi neqiyya. Umi sherotzeh lehachamir al atzmo ulehagilah — lo tob hu oseh, mippene haroim sheyyiru oto keshehu magilah veenan yodein shehi shel pesach heabar, veyomru shehagala moelet lerachat shel chametz. Ella im rotzeh lehachamir al atzmo — yiqneh lo chadasha. Venakon laasot ken lemi sheepshar lo, ki yesh machamirin. Umi shei epshar lo — yagilenna betzina:

Im hotzi matztza chamma mehattannur berachat shel chametz apillu hu tok happesach — day biqlipa sheyyiqlop tachtonit hammatztza shennaga barachat. Veap al pi sheim naga kikkar shel chametz bekikkar shel matztza cham tzarik littol meqom maggao beobi kerochab gudal, mikkol maqom kan sheen hechametz beayin ella balua betok harachat — day biqlipa. Lepikak, im lo hayeta harachat neqiyya umudachat yapeh ella haya bah likluk chametz beayin — tzarik littol bekol tachtonit hammatztza beobi kerochab gudal. Veim hotzi berachat zo od matztzot min hattannur — en tzarik littol mehen kerochab gudal, ella day lahem biqlipa, lepi shehallikluk sheal pene harachat kebar nitqanneach bammatztza harishona. Veim yesh belikluk zeh chashash shamnunit, kegon sheapu berachat zo ugot shel chametz im shumman — hare matztza harishona kullah asura ap im yesh beobyah harbeh yoter merochab gudal, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tm"z, vehaacharonim day lahem biqlipa. Veim nitarebu beharbeh matztzot acherot kesherot — hare hen betelot berob im nitarebu beereb pesach o qodem verotzeh leoklam qodem kenisat lel t"v (perush sherotzeh lebashshelam qodem sheyyoklem, sheasur leekol beereb pesach matztza sheen mebushshelet), kemo shennitbaer kol zeh besiman tm"z:

Matztza shennitchammetza chimmutz gamur vehotziah min hattannur berachat shel pesach — hare nitchammetza harachat, veasur lehotzi bah od matztzot acherot. Veim abar vehotziam — tzarik leqallepam, kemo shennitbaer. Abal im hammatztza lo hayeta chamutza chimmutz gamur, ella shemmachamirin leosrah, kegon matztza nepucha o shennitkappela battannur, sheyyitbaer besiman ts"a, ap shellekattechilla en lehishtammesh bah od, mikkol maqom, bediabad sheabar vehotzi bah od matztzot mehattannur — en tzarik leqallepam. Veken im hu sheat haddechaq, shei epshar limtzo beqal rachat acheret chadasha — hare zeh kediabad, umuttar lehotzi bah od matztzot acherot lekattechilla:

Hashshulchanot sheokelim alehem kol hashshana vehattebot shedderek lehatznia bahen okalim kol hashshana — nahagu kol yisrael lehagilan al yede eruy mikkeli rishon, lepi shellipamim nishpak alehem maraq min haqqedera, u"keboleo kak poleto". Vetzarik lizzaher bekol mishpete haeruy shennitbaer lemala. Veakshav nohagin bimdinot ellu lehagilan al yede eruy im eben melubban, lepi shellipamim mannichim alehem pashtida"a chamma (pat chamma). Abal setam tebot sheen derek lehatznia bahen maakalin chammin — en tzarik lehagilan:

Nohagot hannashim shello lehishtammesh bepesach biqdera sheeru mimmenna rotechin tachat haeben. Veyesh shennatenu taam leminhag zeh lepi mah shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"h shellekattechilla asur learot mikkeli kasher sheyyesh bo shumman kasher letok ner doleq mishshumman terepa, lepi shehahebel oleh mehattachton laelyon derek ammud hannitztzoq hamchabberam, vehu haddin kan, hebel hechametz hanniplat mikkeli hattachton hannigal oleh lehaelyon derek ammud hannitztzoq hamchabberam. (Ulepi taam zeh en leesor ella keshemmeareh al keli hannigal mittok haqqedera atzmah velo nipsaq haqqilluach). Veim abar vehishtammesh bepesach beotah qedera — hare hattabshil muttar apillu baakila:

Kol hakkelim shennishra venikbash bahen chametz k"d shaot retzupim, apillu nikbash bemashqeh tzonen, kegon sheshshara petite lechem bemayim tzonenim veshahu meet leet betok hakkeli — hare zeh keillu nitbashshelu betoko, shekkol hakkabush hu kimbushshal, vetzarik lehagilo betok keli rishon (meiqqar haddin im hu ben yomo mibbeliat haissur, kemo she[ni]tebbaer. Veyesh omerim apillu eno ben yomo). Veen tzarik lomar im amad betoko mashqeh shel chametz, kegon shekar shel chittim useorim vekayyotze bo, shetztzarik lehagilo bikli rishon im amad betoko k"d shaot retzupim (vehu ben yomo, o apillu eno ben yomo, ella sherob tashmish keli zeh kol hashshana hu lehashhot mashqeh chametz betoko meet leet o yoter. Veyesh omerim sheapillu rob tashmisho eno ken veeno ben yomo haddin ken, kemo shennitbaer). Vaapillu hu keli mezuppap mittoko — moelet lo hagala. Im choshesh shello yitrappeh hazzepet al yede harotechin verotzeh lehakshiro belo hagala — yakshirennu al yede milluy veeruy shalosh peamim, dehaynu sheyyemalleennu mayim apillu tzonenin al kol gedotayv veyishhu betoko k"d shaot retzupin o yoter, veachar kak yeareh mimmennu et hammayim vimalleennu mayim acherim veyishhu betoko k"d shaot retzupin o yoter, veachar kak yeareh otam mimmennu veyachazor vimalleennu mayim acherim veyishhu betoko k"d shaot retzupin o yoter, veg' meet leet hallalu enam tzerikim lihyot retzupin, ella apillu mepuzzarin, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman ql"h, ayyen sham kol taame din zeh:

Vaapillu hu keli cheres moil lo milluy veeruy o hagala. Velo ameru shekkeli cheres eno yotze mide dopyo leolam, ella keshennibla bo haissur al yede chammin, o al yede chariput, dehaynu al yede melicha, o shehu bet seor ubet charoset, shechariput hammelach o hasseor vacharoset domeh leroteach. Veken shear kol hakkelim shennibla bahen issur al yede chammin o al yede chariput — en moil lahem ella hagala velibbun. Abal keshennibla bahen haissur betzonen al yede kebisha meet leet, hu niplat gam ken betzonen al yede milluy veeruy. Vaapillu hu keli cheres moelet lo hagala ap im shaha hechametz betoko betzonen yamim veshanim, kegon chabit shel shekar. Veketzad yagil et hechabit sheeno yakol lehaknisah betok keli rishon? Yelabben abanim veyaknisem letok hechabit, veyishpok letokah al haabanim mayim rotechin, veal derek shennitbaer lemala. Vigalgel hechabit kede sheyyaggiu hammayim al kullah. Veqodem hahagala yedichenna bemayim yapeh yapeh. Veim hi shel etz — yiptach echad mishshuleha kede lenaqqer ulehasir kol hazzuhama shebben neser leneser. Veakshav nahagu lehachamir shello lehishtammesh bepesach bechabit shel shekar apillu al yede milluy veeruy vehagala, lepi shei epshar lenaqqer heteb ben hannesarim shello yishshaer sham mashshehu zuhama beayin vehu chametz gamur. Abal chabit shel me debash shennitbashshel beyora shebbishshelu bah shekar, apillu hayeta bat yomah mibbishshul hashshekar — makshirin hechabit lepesach al yede hagala o milluy veeruy, shehare yesh mattirin lishtot hamme debash atzmo bepesach, lepi shehu noten taam ben noten taam, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z ayyen sham. (Ulepi mah shennitbaer sham hayeta hechabit mutteret belo shum heksher, raq sheyyenaqqerah heteb, shehare mah shebbalua bah hu noten taam ben noten taam, vehu muttar ledibre hakkol, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tn"b. Ella shellepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma paam achat haya shekar bechabit zo, o shemma nitchammetz me debash zeh bishmarim shel me debash shennitchammetz beshimre shekar, o shennitbashshel beyora shel yen-sarap, ayyen siman tm"b vtm"z, lekak tzarik lehakshirah):

Venahagu shello lehishtammesh bepesach bekelim shehaya bahen yen-sarap tamid, kegon chabiyyot venodot shedderek lehaknis bahen yen-sarap leqiyyum, veen taam vereach yen-sarap niplat mehen apillu al yede hagala bikli rishon, ugeruim hem mibbet seor vacharoset. Umikkol maqom, im bishshel otam heteb bemayim im eper ad shennistalleq mehem hareach legamre — moelet lahem hagala achar kak:

Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad sheshshakach vehiknis me debash shel pesach letok chabit shel yen-sarap shehigilah kedino, apillu hikniso letokah betok happesach veshaha bah kamma yamim — muttar lishtoto bepesach (im en margishin bo reach yen-sarap ayyen siman tm"g). Umikkol maqom, miyyad shennizkar yeareh oto mechabit zo lechabit acheret shel pesach. Abal im hiknisah letok chabit shel yen-sarap shello hugala kedinah, apillu hikniso letokah qodem happesach veshaha betokah meet leet — asur lishtoto apillu beyom tob haacharon shel galuyyot, ap im lo hayeta hechabit bat yomah mibbeliat hayyen-sarap, shettaam hayyen-sarap eno nipgam apillu leachar kamma yamim, vehu noten taam leshebach beme debash. Abal im hikniso letok chabit shel shekar shello hugala kelal, raq shehedichah heteb techilla min hashshemarim haddebuqim bedapnoteha veshuleha, apillu shaha betokah kamma yamim — muttar lishtoto bepesach (apillu hayeta hechabit) bat yomah mibbeliat hashshekar, shehare beshaa zo shehamme debash bolea taam hashshekar min hechabit, dehaynu besop meet leet achar kenisato letokah, azay barega hahu yesh yoter mimmeet leet libliat hashshekar betok hechabit, ukebar nipgam balua zeh. Veen tzarik lomar im hiknis yayin lechabit shel shekar shello hugala apillu hi bat yomah, shemmuttar lishtoto bepesach apillu shaha betokah kamma yamim, shekkol shekar hu noten taam lipgam beyayin. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheera hayyayin o hamme debash mechabit zo lechabit acheret qodem happesach, shekkol noten taam lipgam shennaasa qodem happesach eno chozer veneor bepesach. Abal im lo era otam ad kenisat happesach — asur lishtoto apillu beyom tob haacharon shel galuyyot lepi minhagenu sheanu oserin noten taam lipgam bepesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello hugala hechabit kelal, abal im higilah vehedichah heteb qodem hahagala, ap al pi shello patach echad mishshuleha lenaqqer ulehasir hazzuhama shebben hannesarim — en zeh meakkeb bediabad leesor bishbil kak et hayyayin o me debash asher betokah. Vaapillu lo higilah betok keli rishon ella al yede eruy mikkeli rishon belo abanim melubbanot — yesh lehattir bediabad (bimqom hepsed merubbeh o sheat haddechaq), sheyyesh lismok al haomerim sheap lekattechilla day lah beeruy mikkeli rishon, kevan shebbeliatah hayeta betzonen, ayyen beyoreh dea siman ql"h:

Tannur shel bet hachorep (perush tannur gadol hammuqqap qkly"n sabib shemmechammemin bo bet hachorep) — asur lehanniach bepesach shum dabar al gabbayv millemala o betok hattannur qatan shebbetoko (perush kemo sheosin bemiqtzat tannure bet hachorep shemmannichin chalal ben haqakalay"n umaqqipin oto beqakalay"n mig' ruchotayv veosin kissuy millemala al oto chalal venaasa ketannur qatan), kedin keli cheres shennishtammesh bo chametz bechammin shennitbaer lemala, shehare kol hashshana regilut lehanniach sham pashtida"a ushear chametz beshaa shehattannur mitchammem, venibla sham taam chametz al yede chom haur, veeno yotze mide dopyo leolam. Vaapillu im rotzeh lehassiq et hattannur hesseq gadol — ap al pi ken en hechametz niplat mishsham al yede hesseq zeh shehu betok chalal hattannur, shehare en hechametz nibla sham derek chalal hattannur ella derek gabbayv, u"keboleo kak poleto", kemo shennitbaer lemala. Umi sherotzeh lehishtammesh bepesach al gabbe hattannur — manniach alayv chatikat barzel o shear dabar sheen mishtammeshin bo bepesach, veal gabbe zeh haddabar hammapsiq muttar lehanniach apillu maakalim chammim beshaa shehattannur mitchammem bepesach. Abal im hinniach sadin alayv — en lehanniach al hassadin ella maakal tzonen beshaa shehattannur tzonen, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal betok hattannur qatan shebbetoko en lehanniach tabshil (roteach) apillu al gabbe chatikat barzel, vaapillu hattannur hu tzonen, lepi sheap gaggo shel tannur qatan zeh hu balua mechametz, shehare kol hashshana mannichin betoko qederot rotechot, veoleh hahebel mehattabshil shebbaqqederot venibla begaggo. Veap al pi sheggag zeh lo hizzia zea chamma shehayyad soledet bo, ulepikak eno oser bediabad im heemid tachtayv qedera rotachat sheheemidu tachtayv bepesach, mikkol maqom lekattechilla en lehaamidah sham ella im ken hetiach betit et kol hattannur qatan zeh mittoko veet gaggo veet qirotayv sabib veet qarqaito, vihe obi hattit kerochab gudal, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"a:

Veim shakach vehinniach matztza chamma betok tannur qatan zeh o al gabbe tannur bet hachorep beli shum dabar hammapsiq benetayim — tzarik liqlop tachtoniyyut hammatztza shennaga begup hattannur (dekevan shehaissur hu balua battannur eno oser yoter mikkede qelipa apillu betok happesach kemo shennitbaer lemala), apillu haya hattannur tzonen. Veim haya hattannur cham, ap al pi shehammaakal shehinniach alayv haya tzonen — tzarik littol mimmennu kede qelipa. Veim hu maakal shamen — kullo asur. Uleminhag medinot ellu sheen mechalleqin ben kachush leshamen — bekol inyan kullo asur, ella im ken hu maakal sheen shayyak bo shamnunit, kegon matztza vekayyotze bo, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z:

Abal im hinniach sham tabshil biqdera, apillu haya hattannur cham — hattabshil muttar. Apillu im meqom moshab haqqedera haya meluklak mechametz beayin, ap al pi ken im en bo chashash shamnunit — eno oser yoter mikkede qelipa, uboobi shule haqqedera yesh yoter mikkede qelipa. Vegam haqqedera yesh lehattir im bari lo shemmeqom moshabah haya naqi, shello haya sham mashshehu chametz beayin, shehaissur habbalua battannur eno niplat laqqedera shealayv, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"b, sheen issur balua yotze middopen ledopen belo roteb, ayyen sham:

Veken im hinniach qederot rotechot bepesach betok hattannur shel bet hachorep leachar shehussaq kebar, ap al pi shellipamim mannichin sham qedera shel chametz — hare hattabshil muttar apillu baakila, vegam haqqedera mutteret im haya meqom moshabah naqi mechametz beayin. Veap al pi sheggag hattannur hizzia tachtayv mibbipnim mechamat chom hattabshil shettachtayv, ubezea zo yesh taam chametz shenniplat letokah miggag hattannur shennibla bo taam chametz al yede hazzea shehizzia keshehayu tachtayv qederot rotechot, mikkol maqom kevan shekkebar hussaq hattannur — hare nitlabben gaggo al yede hashshalhebet venisrap kol hechametz habbalua bo. Veap al pi shekkeshehissiq et hattannur lo nitkavven lehakshir gaggo lepesach al yede hesseq zeh — en kavvana zo meakkebet bediabad, ayyen siman ts"a:

Kele cheres hamtzuppim mittokam behittuk zekukit sheqqorin (gyglyyzr"t) — en dinam kikle zekukit sheyyesh makshirin otam belo hagala lepi sheenam boleim kelum, ella hare hem kikle cheres, sheapillu hagala enah moelet lahem im nishtammesh bahen chametz bechammin, dekevan shehazzekukit hu mechuppeh al hacheres venitzrap immo bakkibshan — hare hu bolea kamohu. Veyesh meqomot shennahagu shello lehishtammesh bepesach bikle cheres hamtzuppim betokam bizkukit, apillu hem chadashim shello nishtammesh bahen chametz meolam, lepi shemmiqtzat haummanim osim peullat hatztzippuy al yede subbin, vahare yesh kan chametz balua betok hatztzippuy. Abal kele cheres sheenan metzuppim ella shennittap alayv meat zekukit mitztzippuy keli acher — muttar lehishtammesh bo im hu chadash, lepi sheachar kak maknisin oto lekibshan o letannur male esh venisrap hassubbin shebbo, sheen haumman chas alayv lesorpo uletzorpo heteb, kevan sheeno metzuppeh bizkukit eno mitqalqel kelum baesh. Abal oto keli cheres shehu metzuppeh bizkukit chas alayv shello yitqalqel hazzekukit shebbo mechamat chom haesh, ulekak memaher hu lehotzio min haesh, ulepikak machamirin shello lehishtammesh bahem bepesach:

Umikkol maqom, en lehachamir ella bimqomot shennahagu lehachamir. Vegam beotan meqomot, im bari lo shekkeli cheres zeh lo erab haumman subbin batztzippuy — yesh lehaqel lehishtammesh bo bepesach im en sham minhag yadua lehachamir gam bazeh. Ulepikak nohagim biqtzat meqomot shello lehishtammesh bahen bepesach apillu hem chadashim, ella im ken amad hayyisrael al gabbe haumman lirot shello yetaqqen tzippuy habbedil vehatztzeba al yede subbin. Veen lehachamir bazeh ella bimqom hamminhag, shemmeiqqar haddin en lachosh lazeh, shehare en habbedil o hatztzeba mitdabbeqin bakkeli ella al yede libbun hakkeli baesh, vaazay nisrap kol mammashut hassubbin. Velo od, ella apillu keli matteket yashan shennitbashshel bo chametz kol hashshana veachar kak chippahu bibdil — yesh lehattir meiqqar haddin lehishtammesh bo bepesach belo hagala, lepi shehallibbun shemmelabbenim oto bishat tzippuy maplit haissur mimmennu kemo sheim haya magilo, shehare haesh mechammemo kol kak mibbachutz ad shehabbedil nittak betoko mibbipnim, velibbun kazeh eno garua mehagala, kevan shehayyad soledet bo mishshene abarayv mibbayit umichutz bekol shetach hakkeli. Ella lepi shellipamim osim zeh hatztzippuy bimhirut veeno oleh bekol shetach hakkeli lepi shello hirtichu oto yapeh, vezeh matzuy meod, lepikak nakon lehorot sheyyagilu otam achar hatztzippuy (veim haumman shetztzippahu hu nokri — tzarik lehatbilo belo beraka achar hatztzippuy qodem hahagala, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"k). Abal keli cheres yashan hamchuppeh bibdil o operet — apillu hagala velibbun en moilin lo lehakshiro, kedin keli cheres sheeno nikshar al yede hagala velibbun. Veap al pi shechippahu keshehaya chadash sheadayin lo nishtammesh bo velo nibla kelum behacheres ad leachar shechippahu beoperet veaz operet hu mapsiq ben hacheres uben hechametz shennishtammesh betoko — en zeh moil kelum lihyot niddon kikle mattakot hanniksharim al yede hagala, lepi keshennishtammesh bo chametz bechammin nibla hechametz bekol obi hakkeli, venibla gam bacheres shettachat haoperet, veshub eno niplat mimmennu leolam:

Kele etz hamtzuppim besamemanim dinam kikle cheres, sheen hagala moelet lahem im nishtammesh bahem chametz bechammin, shehassamemanim meakkebim al me hahagala shello yaplitu mah shebbalua betok haetz shettachtehem. (Abal im lo nishtammesh bahem chametz — enam asurim bepesach ella bemaqom shennahagu lehachamir, kemo shennitbaer lemala):

Kol kele hashshetiyya, ben kosot ben tzelochiyyot ben qanqannim, apillu hem shel cheres, kevan shettashmishan betzonen kol hashshana — hare lo nibla bahem kelum, ulepikak en tzarik lehagilan kelal, ella day lahem bishtipa meiqqar haddin (abal hamminhag hu shello lehishtammesh bepesach kelal bikle cheres yeshanim kemo shennitbaer lemala), dehaynu sheyyedichem vishapshepem heteb bemayim kede lehasir ulemareq haissur haddabuq bahem beayin, veachar kak chozer veshotepan bemayim beli shipshup, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman qk"a, umuttar lehishtammesh bahen achar kak apillu bechammin. Veap al pi shellipamim mannichin otam etzel haesh lechammem bahen yayin venotenim petite lechem chametz bayyayin hacham shebbetokan, vegam kosot shel etz lipamim mearin letokam shekar cham im shekar tzonen, velipamim shoheh betokam meet leet venaasa kabush kimbushshal kemo shennitbaer lemala, mikkol maqom kevan sherob tashmishan kol hashshana hu betzonen pachot mimmeet leet — lo hechemiru bahen chakamim lehagilam im eno ben yomo mibbeliat hechametz shennibla bahen al yede chammin o al yede kebisha meet leet. Abal kelim sherob tashmishan kol hashshana hu lehashhot mashqeh chametz betokam meet leet o yoter, kegon chabit vekaddim shel shekar — tzarik lehakshiram al yede milluy veeruy o al yede hagala bikli rishon ap im enam bene yoman. Uledibre haomerim sheen holekim behagalat kelim achar rob tashmishan — ap kosot utzelochit tzarik lehakshir al yede milluy veeruy o al yede hagala bikli rishon. Veken hamminhag pashut bimdinot ellu, veen leshannot. Abal im abar velo hikshiram kelal raq shehedicham veshipshepam heteb vehishtammesh bahen bepesach apillu bechammin — hare chammin hallalu muttarin, lepi shebbediabad somekin al sebara harishona:

Kol kele zekukit, apillu nishtammesh bahen chametz bechammin kol hashshana, vaapillu otam sheshshaha mashqeh chametz betokam kamma yamim veshanim, kegon tzelochiyyot sheppihem tzar shedderek lehaknis bahem shekar leqiyyum — en tzerikim shum heksher lepesach, ella day lahem bishtipa kedinah, lepi shehem chalaqim veqashim veenan boleim kelum. Veyesh omerim sheapillu hagala enah moelet likle zekukit shennishtammesh bahen chametz bechammin o al yede kebisha meet leet, dekevan shettechillat beriyyatan hu min hachol — hare hen kikle cheres. Veken hamminhag pashut bimdinot ellu. Lepikak nohagin shello lehishtammesh bepesach beshum keli zekukit sheyyesh lachosh bo shemma eru letoko mashqeh chametz cham o shemma nishtaha betoko mashqeh chametz meet leet. Abal im abar vehishtammesh bo bepesach apillu bechammin belo shum heksher — hare chammin hallalu muttarin im rob tashmish keli zeh kol hashshana hu betzonen pachot meet leet. Abal im rob tashmisho kol hashshana hu bechammin, o apillu betzonen ella sherob happeamim derek lehashhot mashqeh chametz betoko meet leet o yoter, kegon tzelochiyyot sheppihem tzar shedderek lehaknis bahen yen-sarap leqiyyum — ap bediabad asurin hachammin shennishtammeshu bo o hammashqeh sheamad bo meet leet, ella im ken hikshiro qodem shennishtammesh bo al yede hagala o al yede milluy veeruy:

Kele kesep hamtzuyyarim batztzad happenimit shellahem behittuk zekukit (sheqqorin gyshmaltz"t) — en lehishtammesh bo bepesach lekattechilla apillu al yede hagala lepi minhag medinatenu shemmachamirin kehaomerim sheen hagala moelet lizkukit. Abal im hu batztzad hachitzon shel hakkeli — muttar lehishtammesh bo bepesach al yede hagala o al yede milluy veeruy, shehare hahittuk zekukit shemmibbachutz lo bala kelum mehechametz shennishtammesh bo mibbipnim. Veap shellipamim eru letoko chametz roteach, ukeli mattakot shecham miqtzato cham kullo, venitchammem gam tzad hachitzon shel hakkeli venibla sham taam hechametz bazzekukit haqqabua sham (kemo shennitbaer lemala sheyyesh soberin ken), mikkol maqom kesheyyishtammesh bo bepesach lo yihyeh niplat kelum mehazzekukit lammashqeh shebbetoko ap im yihyeh mashqeh roteach veal yede ken yitchammem gam tzad hachitzon shel hakkeli, shekkeli mattakot shecham miqtzato cham kullo, mikkol maqom miqtzat chom zeh sheeno cham ella mechamat chom miqtzat hashsheni — en lo koach lehaplit giul habbalua sham uleholiko lammiqtzat hashsheni, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"d. (Veen chosheshin shemma yartiach bo mashqeh etzel haesh betok happesach veyitchammem tzad hachitzon shel hakkeli chom gadol mechamat haesh veyiplot taam hechametz habbalua behittuk zekukit haqqebua bo, lepi sheen derek kelal lehartiach etzel haesh kele kesep chashubim hamtzuyyarim):

Opot shennitzlu bepesach beshappud yashan shekkol hashshana tzalu bo basar maluach bemelach shello nibdaq mipperure chametz sheddarkam lehimmatze ben hammelach — hare opot hallalu muttarin, kevan sheen bashshappud chametz vadday ella chashash sepeq perure chametz shebben hammelach, umissapeq en leesor bediabad, ki en machaziqin issur missapeq. Abal im paam achat tzalu beshappud zeh muleyta o shear chametz apillu mashshehu ubepesach tzalu bo basar belo heksher benetayim — hare basar zeh asur apillu bahanaa (im hashshappud hu ben yomo, uleminhagenu apillu eno ben yomo), shemmashshehu chametz shennibla bashshappud qodem happesach lo nitbattel betoko beshishshim, mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"t ayyen sham:

Nohagin lehadiach habberazot shebbechabiyyot shel yayin shemmistappeqin mehen kol hashshana verotzeh lehistappeq mehen bepesach, lepi shekkol hashshana mishtammeshin babberazot beyadayim hamluklakot mechametz:

Haetzim shettochabim bahem kele shetiyya shel shekar bevadday nitlaklek haetz milliklukit hashshekar shebbetok hakkeli, kevan shehaetz nitchab letok chalal hakkeli, ulepikak en litchob bo kelim bepesach ella im ken hedicho yapeh:
